title: Analytics menu shows the analytics pages
problem: The Analytics menu listed pixel setup pages while the real analytics pages were hidden in the reports list.
now: Analytics lists Reports, Daily summary, Scheduled reports and the marketing, campaign, attribution, traffic, team and alert pages.
steps: Open the Analytics area in the menu
Open Settings › Connections › Meta ads to reach Pixels & events
notes: Where: Menu › Analytics; pixel setup now under Settings › Connections
